    ADVANCED CHOICE

    Protection will be off

    Headroom lowers the signal before EQ so boosted frequencies stay below digital full scale. Turning it off can cause audible distortion at the output or during encoding.

    • UZjam will keep your exact curve and apply no protective attenuation.
    • The graph and meters will stay red whenever clipping is possible.
    • You can turn protection back on at any time.
